verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a SaaS work-management platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents choosing a storage region or residency. The closest items, SOC 2/HIPAA/ISO certified infrastructure and 'Your data never leaves our secure servers', describe security posture, not user-selectable data location, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
